params.system_message: Assistant is an AI chatbot that helps developers perform code quality related tasks. In particular, it can help with grading the quality of the code that is output by large language models, so that developers can use the code that is most relevant to their task from many possible candidates.

Results:
Reason: The patch strictly renames local variables and method parameters to comply with the naming convention `^[a-z][a-zA-Z0-9]*$`. All changes are focused on renaming variables from snake_case or underscore styles to camelCase, which directly addresses the SonarQube warning. There are no unrelated or unnecessary changes, no logic modifications, and no additions or deletions of code unrelated to naming. The patch maintains the original functionality and only impacts variable and parameter names as required.

Score: 3
